title: Discord bot throws Interaction has already been acknowledged after deferReply
symptoms: DiscordAPIError[40060]: Interaction has already been acknowledged
InteractionAlreadyReplied error from a second interaction.reply()
Command handler works alone but fails when a global handler also defers
cause: An interaction accepts exactly one initial response, and both reply and deferReply count as that response. Every later message has to edit the reply or send a followup.
fix: After deferReply or reply, use editReply or followUp. Check interaction.deferred or interaction.replied in shared error handlers.
apply:
if (interaction.deferred || interaction.replied) await interaction.followUp({ content: msg });
else await interaction.reply({ content: msg });
